messages:
clare_sales: Starting thread for NorthBank POC. Requirements: BYO-HSM attestation, KMIP + PKCS#11 support, weekly KEK rotation, 21-day external pen-test, and pricing comparison per-op vs fixed premium.

ben_se: Quick clarifier: weekly rotation means KEK rewrap every 7 days, correct? That will need staged rewrap and dual-KEK acceptance.

client_sec_lead: Yes weekly. Pilot can be biweekly. Production must be weekly with audit logs and ability to roll back to prior KEK for 24h.

pia_security: Security asks: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or equivalent, signed vendor attestations, and SOC2 + PCI reports. Pen-test window OK with 48h notice and scoped endpoints.

raj_ops: Ops constraints: per-request unwrap to BYO-HSM increases p99 by ~80-150ms. Recommend cached wrapped keys with TTL 15m for non-sensitive flows to limit HSM ops. For weekly rotation we'll need a canary rollout and automated fallback.

finance_bot: Ballpark pricing: reserved capacity base $18k/mo. BYO-HSM attestation premium +22% (~$4k/mo). Per-op surcharge option $0.0006/op. One-time onboarding $20k for runbooks and attestation validation.

ben_se: I'll draft a 1-page SOW addendum (rotation/fallback/pen-test scoping) and post before EOD.

pia_security: I'll compile required artifact checklist and confirm acceptable FIPS equivalence.

clare_sales: Action items noted. 1) Ben: SOW addendum; 2) Pia: security checklist; 3) Raj: runbook draft; 4) Finance: formal quote. Sync tomorrow 10am PT.

client_sec_lead: We'll provide attestation certs and allowlist IPs by EOD. Also please include a sample "KEK Rotation SLA" clause for review.

clare_sales: Will do. Ping me @clare_sales for urgent blockers. :white_check_mark:
